chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, from Muthanna, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «The pilgrimage is (for) well-known months». He said: Shawwal, Dhu'l-Qa'da and Dhu'l-Hijjah. In another narration: And one singular month for Umrah, Rajab.

key_terms.ذُو الْحِجَّةِ: Dhu'l-Hijjah (the 12th month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ: Dhu'l-Qa'da (the 11th month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.رَجَبٌ: Rajab (the 7th month of the Islamic calendar)
key_terms.شَوَّالٌ: Shawwal (the 10th month of the Islamic calendar)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific months designated for Hajj and Umrah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explicitly defines the 'well-known months' (Ashhur Ma'lumat) of Surah Al-Baqarah as Shawwal, Dhu'l-Qa'da, and Dhu'l-Hijjah, establishing the temporal framework for the Hajj rituals. It further distinguishes Rajab as a singular month specifically designated for Umrah, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the distinct legal status and timing of minor pilgrimage. This clarification underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition in determining the sacred calendar for Islamic rites.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, from Muthanna, from Zurara, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «The pilgrimage is (for) well-known months» [2:197]. He said: Shawwal, Dhu’l-Qa’da and Dhu’l-Hijjah. In another narration: And one singular month for Umrah, Rajab.
